Main koi pakshi nahi; aur koi jaal mujhe nahi baandhta; main azaad hoon.
Azaadi ek bhaari bojh, ek bada aur ajeeb bharam hai.
Joy amartya (eternal) ka anubhav hai.
Azaadi creativity ki buniyad hai.
Azaadi pragati ki oxygen hai.
Curiosity pack karo, certainty ko peeche chhod do.
Azaadi sochne aur karne ka adhikar hai.
Azaadi vichar ki mukti hai.
Khushi imandari se jeena hai.
Khushi ek itra hai jise doosron par chirke bina kuch aap par nahi lagta.
Bina kisi purpose ke wander karo, apni rooh dhoondo.
Azadi bolne ki kshamta hai.
Jahan apne vichar kehne ki azaadi na ho, wahan azaadi bematlab hai.
Khushi geet hai.
Azaadi zulm ke khilaf sabse bada hathiyar hai.
Saccha anand aatma ki sakriyata se aata hai.
Khushi shanti hai.
Khushi dimaag ka ek attitude hai, jo har halat mein khush rehne ki zid se paida hota hai.
Khushi doosron ko khush karne ki koshish ka parinam hai.
Khushi se zyada anand jeevan ka antim lakshya hai, kyunki anand dard ke beech bhi ho sakta hai.
Khushi aatma ki swabhavik sthiti hai.
Azaadi manav vikas ka antim lakshya hai.
